title: Troubleshooting
subtitle: Check installations, launch paths, bundled components, proxy setup, and prerequisites to find why a tool will not launch or connect.
purpose: Diagnostics inspect install paths and settings, then suggest a next step for each result.
networkNote: These checks do not send model API calls or proxy internet requests. Proxy and model tests run separately after your confirmation; a successful test does not prove that the app itself routes traffic through the proxy.

checks.fonts: Vazirmatn font and Nerd Font glyphs
checks.ohmyposh: Oh My Posh and shell profile

nextActions.pass: This check found no issue. If the tool still will not launch or connect, review the related result and the app guide.
nextActions.review: This result is inconclusive; review the path or tool state, then run a focused test if needed.
nextActions.default: Read the details, open the related setting, and run the check again after making a change.
nextActions.apps: Open the Installed filter in Apps and review the path/version. Install or rescan the app if it is missing.
nextActions.focusedTool: This only confirms that an executable path exists. Repair the install if no path was found; otherwise open the app and test its model connection separately.
nextActions.editors: Refresh Home. If an editor is missing, repair its installation and scan again.
nextActions.rtlAdapters: Open the app details and install its RTL prerequisites; RTL is not supported by every tool.
nextActions.proxyConfig: In Proxy, choose a default profile or app assignment, then test port, negotiation, and internet request separately.
nextActions.modelConnections: Save a connection in Models & Connections, confirm its model test, then enter the settings manually in a compatible tool.
nextActions.runtime: Repair the VibeHub installation to restore the bundled runtime.
nextActions.rtlState: Close and relaunch the app. Stop only processes VibeHub has identified as its own.
nextActions.ports: Check that an earlier VibeHub run has closed; do not terminate an unknown process automatically.
nextActions.proxy: Confirm the proxy service is listening on the configured host and port, then run the tests on the Proxy page.
nextActions.fonts: Install the recommended font from Settings → PowerShell appearance; it does not change fonts inside other tools.
nextActions.ohmyposh: Install Oh My Posh, then configure the PowerShell prompt from the same Settings section.
nextActions.catalog: Check internet access and the feed URL, then sync content again.
nextActions.network: Check internet access, the Windows clock, and TLS certificates, then retry.
nextActions.updater: Check for the official update again; the package signature must remain valid.
nextActions.crash: Review details locally and copy the sanitized report for support.

noSecrets: Copied reports redact local paths and text that resembles keys, passwords, or access tokens.
